# The people who maintain this repository, for the changelog's crediting rule.
#
# A contributor from outside this list is credited in the changelog entry;
# someone on it is not, because a maintainer being thanked for maintaining
# the project is noise. "Outside the team" is not "outside Canonical": a
# Canonical colleague from another team is a contributor here.
#
# The propose-release workflow passes these to the changelog tool as one
# comma-separated --team. Entries are email addresses and GitHub handles;
# the git log carries the address, so an address is what usually matches,
# and a handle catches anyone committing from a no-reply address.
#
# Leaving someone off over-credits them, which is visible in the draft
# release and takes one edit to fix. Adding someone who should be credited
# is invisible until they notice. So when in doubt, leave them off.
#
# One entry per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
